section.name: EBApplicability20261008
section.heading: End-bent model reconciliation
section.paragraph: Both end bents follow the controlling End Bent 1 configuration by user direction. The user confirms the cap report contains the latest FBMP model; loaded nodes are 15 and 34 after model refinement. Shared square-pile geometry and the separate 30-in end-bent pedestal are recorded in Bridge Geometry. The p-multiplier discussion below remains for pier pipe piles. The different same-named Downloads XML is not the source model. This update does not rerun FBMP or verify raw input loads absent from the report; backwall and cheek-wall quantities remain deferred.

section.name: PierSourceReconciliation
section.heading: Pier model source — 9 October 2026
section.paragraph: The current pier record uses the exact Pier_MinTip.XML matching Pier Cap Design 10-9.html (SHA256 cb094424ed16e60b16957ed84a62aea21533fb61671c58a27ca73a997eaf70e4). Cap section, 230-in length, four 20-in pipes, 60-in spacing, 103-in bearing separation and effective pipe-section properties reconcile to displayed precision. Actual right bearing offset +10.14 in differs from the journal +10.50 in. Full load application, independent wall/wind envelopes and structural adequacy remain outside this source-data acceptance; no FBMP rerun is claimed.
